items.title: Sammy Penn Interview, 1960-04-21
items.q: Yeah, I know him, but I don't think this Johnson was a relation to him at all.

ctx.x: Bass, violin. Is there any relation, any chance, to the Toot Johnson? They were up in the Baton Rouge, I think, around there.
Yeah, I know him, but I don't think this Johnson was a relation to him at all. No, sir. But I know who you're speaking of, but there are no relations.
Well now, did he show you anything about the, you say you learned mostly about them from Jake Johnson, did he show you anything about the rhythms or the beats or anything or did you pick that up?
